_about: PC-only build depth (docs/concepts/combat-system-depth.md; spark combat-system-depth WP1, 2026-10-23). Every input is neutral at its default: absent agility = rank 1 = no effect, absent spell rank = rank 1 = the row's own numbers, absent enemy level = level 1 = today's HP; effects scale with (rank - 1). States that run balance 'canonical' (the VR parity suites) ignore this whole file. agility: a fourth arena stat with no movement effect, trained on the same points curve as vigor/focus/nerve (stats.csv 0;6;14;24;36). castMultPerRank scales the caster's cast and windup (a defender-facing warning never drops below its reaction-band floor); perfectWindowAddSPerRank widens the perfect-absorb window; recoveryMultPerRank scales recovery after casts, ward releases (the re-raise gap), staff strikes and rolls; drainMultPerRank scales the absorb drain and stacks multiplicatively with nerve, which keeps its own rule. spellRanks: ranks 1-4 are power only (power[r-1] multiplies damage and effect size; cost, cast time and cooldown unchanged); rank 5 is rank 4 power plus the row's ultimate form when one is registered in ultimates (keyed by spell id; WP3, six forms: one signature row per archetype per school, every other row's rank 5 is power only). An ultimate is { name, summary, effect, params }: root (rootS), slow (slowMult, slowS), heat (heatPerHit), momentum (momentumPerHit), extraProjectiles (count), embers (tickDamage, tickS, durationS); progression.ts checks each effect's keys, ranges and that the row's shape can carry it. enemyLevels: regular enemies (soldiers, creatures) at level L (= campaign week, season.json weeks) have hpMult[L-1] times their authored HP; named rivals and mage entrants are not scaled. Unknown keys and out-of-shape numbers fail at load.

fire_flick.name: Searing Hold
fire_flick.summary: Close (fire_close). A target the cone reaches (damage through, not a perfect absorb) is rooted: it cannot walk or roll out of the brawler's 4 m reach for the follow-up.

fire_bolt.name: Kindling Darts
fire_bolt.summary: Light (fire_light). Each Ember Dart that connects pays more Heat, so the stream reaches Kindled and Blazing in the first tiers.

fire_wrath.name: Brand Drag
fire_wrath.summary: Heavy (fire_heavy). Each Brand Wrath tick that reaches its target (damage through, not a perfect absorb) drags it to slowMult of its speed, so the channel is hard to walk off once tier IV opens.

air_shear.name: Pinning Edge
air_shear.summary: Close (air_close). A blade that reaches its target (damage through, not a perfect absorb) roots it for rootS, so the brawler's next exchange starts inside its reach. Replaced Third Blade (+1 blade down the aim line), which took air_close from 18 % to 0 % reference wins over rank 4 (D1 section 6.2).

air_bolt.name: Headwind
air_bolt.summary: Light (air_light). A Gale Dart that reaches its target (damage through, not a perfect absorb) slows it, so a chaser cannot close the skirmisher's band.

air_cyclone.name: Eye-wall
air_cyclone.summary: Heavy (air_heavy). Each Cyclone tick that reaches its target (damage through, not a perfect absorb) roots it, so it cannot walk off the channel.
